senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m., בן י׳ Ben Yakeh, an homiletical surname of king Solomon.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:4">Num. R. s. 10</cite> <he>בן י׳ שהקיא וכ׳</he> Solomon is named Ben Yakeh (a son of discharge) for he discharged (abandoned) the words of the Law, like a vessel which is filled in its time and emptied in its time; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:1:2">Koh. R. to I, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:10">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite>.
